text_block_list.text:
By chance, I spotted Shinko Windy in the fields.
There's a shovel by her side. It seems she's trying to dig a pitfall trap, but...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...
I'm gonna blow everyone's minds...

Shinko Windy began digging a hole.
However, she stopped almost immediately...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh...
I have no energy left...

With so many races back-to-back, Shinko Windy seems to have built up considerable fatigue.
I might need to rethink her upcoming schedule.
